options.name: addresses
options.description: Destination IP addresses, FQDNs, or wildcard FQDNs added to the group.

options.name: api_key
options.description: A string that contains the obfuscated API key.

options.name: client_id
options.description: The client ID for OAuth2 authentication.

options.name: client_secret
options.description: The client secret for OAuth2 authentication.

options.name: cloud
options.description: The Zscaler cloud name provisioned for your organization.

options.name: countries
options.description: This option is available only when the attribute type is set to DSTN_OTHER Destination IP address countries. You can identify destinations based on the location of a server. Supports 2-letter ISO3166 Alpha2 Country i.e BR, CA, US. Please visit the following site for reference U(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_ISO_3166_country_codes)

options.name: description
options.description: Additional information about the destination IP group.

options.name: id
options.description: Unique identifier for the destination IP group.

options.name: ip_categories
options.description: Destination IP address URL categories. You can identify destinations based on the URL category of the domain. There are hundreds of categories available such as ANY, NONE, SOCIAL_ADULT, OTHER_BUSINESS_AND_ECONOMY, etc. Visit for choices U(https://help.zscaler.com/zia/firewall-policies#/ipDestinationGroups-get).

options.name: name
options.description: Destination IP group name.

options.name: password
options.description: A string that contains the password for the API admin.

options.name: private_key
options.description: The private key for JWT-based OAuth2 authentication.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict containing authentication credentials.

options.name: sandbox_cloud
options.description: The Sandbox cloud environment for API access.

options.name: sandbox_token
options.description: A string that contains the Sandbox API Key.

options.name: state
options.description: Specifies the desired state of the resource.

options.name: type
options.description: Destination IP group type (i.e., the group can contain destination IP addresses or FQDNs).

options.name: url_categories
options.description: This option is available only when the attribute type is set to DSTN_OTHER To identify destinations based on the URL category of a domain, select the required URL categories. If no category is selected, the field remains set to Any, and the criteria will be ignored during policy evaluation. Only custom URL categories are supported

options.name: use_legacy_client
options.description: Whether to use the legacy Zscaler API client.

options.name: username
options.description: A string that contains the email ID of the API admin.

options.name: vanity_domain
options.description: The vanity domain provisioned by Zscaler for OAuth2 flows.
